text:
Sam: Posted the IO eviction postmortem. We need to convert remediation items into tests + owners. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/io-cache-2026

Priya: Agree. Split work: deterministic replay regression, sustained 90m working-set load, promptset/eval additions, and a staged chaos run. Who volunteers?

Marta: I'll own the regression harness (replay + pressure toggle). Deliverable: PR with tests + README + nightly job. ETA 10 business days.

Kai: I'll extract and sanitize two representative traces and place them in s3://incidents/io-eviction/2026-samples/. Will scrub IDs and PHI. ETA 48h.

Taylor: I can take promptsets and evals. Plan: create two promptsets (short/long context) and an eval that checks latency (P95) and correctness. Acceptance: P95 <= 1.3x baseline, accuracy delta < 1%. ETA 7 days.

Priya: I'll open PERF-5010 "eviction-90m-sustained" and schedule the load orchestration. Assigned to me, due 14 days. JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PERF-5010

ops-bot: Ticket PERF-5010 created and linked to postmortem IO-CACHE-2026. CI template `eviction-regression-nightly` available.

Marta: Test naming suggestion for discoverability:
```
tests/evals/eviction/
  - eviction_replay.yaml
  - eviction_workingset_90m.yaml
labels: ["regression","eviction","kv","chaos","nightly"]
```

Marta: I'll open the harness PR once traces are available and include a small deterministic trace replay example.

Kai: Scrubbed trace bundles will be attached to PERF-5010 in ~48h. Also will request a temporary infra quota bump for the 90m run.

Sam: Chaos plan: tabletop first (20-30m) then one controlled staging run. Marta lead live run, Kai infra, Taylor evals. I'll schedule tabletop and confirm drill date.

Priya: Dependencies noted in PERF-5010: sanitized traces, infra quota, and CI minutes. I've CC'd infra-schedule and finance.

Marta: Checklist I'll maintain in PR description: 1) harness + tests, 2) sanitized traces, 3) CI job wired, 4) PERF-5010 link, 5) acceptance criteria doc.

Taylor: I'll add golden baseline outputs and an example runner command to the PR.

Sam: Owners recap: Marta (harness + live run), Taylor (promptsets + evals), Priya (load orchestration + JIRA), Kai (traces + infra), Sam (tabletop + follow-up). Please add firm ETAs into PERF-5010 comments by EOD.

ops-bot: CI job `eviction-regression-nightly` scheduled to run daily at 03:00 UTC once harness PR merges.

Marta: One more: propose alert automation draft: if eviction rate > 0.5% for 10m AND P99 tail > 2x baseline, auto-open an ops breadcrumbs ticket. I'll add to the alerts RFC.

Kai: Also propose a synthetic that asserts small-key hit ratio every 5m and fires early if it drops > 10%.

Sam: Thanks team. I'll convert this thread into the postmortem follow-up doc and link to PERF-5010 + PRs. We'll reconvene after tabletop. :thumbsup:
